terra.problem: The cookie-stamper punchline has no clear connection to the errand or the animals, so the joke does not pass the logic test.
The paperwork joke has no clear connection to why the prophet says King rather than governor.
The explanation is flat, and saying a donkey and gentle go together does not illuminate the passage.
The text calls them cloaks, not a saddle, and does not say nobody was walking beside the donkey.
The text does not say the people were wearing the cloaks or that everybody found a way to join in.
The text does not describe the cloaks as plain or say the items were whatever the people had right there.
Saying he would have been out there with a broom places Papa Dorin hypothetically in a Bible event.
The text says the crowds were shouting, but does not say everybody shouted at once.
The city asks who Jesus is, but the explanation asserts what its people knew and why they had to ask.
The question does not establish that nobody in the city had an answer ready.
Having had one drawer has no clear connection to keeping towns straight, so the joke does not pass the logic test.
